target.title: ci(loc): exclude the i18n catalog and make baseline raises reviewable
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The LOC ratchet from #105894 dead-ends: the versioned-baseline comparison rejects every raised or added baseline entry, so any PR that grows a 500+-line file — or adds a new one, or touches the generated i18n catalog — fails `check-guards` with no legal path. At tonight's merge velocity main re-reds every few minutes (observed cycles: locale bundles, `media/store.ts`, `icons.ts`, `channel-compat-normalization.ts`, codex/matrix files).

## Why This Change Was Made

Two changes, maintainer-approved:
1. `ui/src/i18n/locales/` is excluded from the gate — `en.ts` is the string catalog and the other 20 bundles are generated; they grow with every key and cannot be split.
2. Baseline raises become legal but must land as visible `ts-max-loc-baseline.json` diffs in the same PR — the same contract as the deadcode exports ratchet. The check still fails any file above its baseline (forcing the raise to be explicit) and still forces baselines down after splits. The base-ref comparison, its git plumbing, and the update-refusal are deleted; `--base-ref` is retired (CI still fetches `loc-base` for the temp-creation report). Codex review flagged the bypass-by-baseline-edit risk; consciously accepted and documented at the check site — repo policy ("do not edit baseline files without approval") and PR review are the backstop, exactly as for the deadcode baseline.

## User Impact

None at runtime. Unblocks all currently-red PRs and future i18n/string additions.

## Evidence

- `pnpm check:loc` red on plain main (21 locale rows + rotating growth violations); green with this change after `check:loc:update`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/check-ts-max-loc.test.ts` green (retired-flag failure case + i18n exclusion case added; versioned/update-refusal tests deleted with their paths).
- Net −166 lines.
